_notes.authority: Normative for relic names, codes, rarity, archetype, hooks and rules. Governed by MECHANICS.md.
_notes.codes: Codes are OPAQUE string primary keys. They are not sequential and do not sort by archetype. Sort by archetype/rarity fields. Codes already rendered in the design files are preserved exactly.
_notes.rule_vs_flavor: `rule` is normative and implementable. `flavor` is display copy and carries no mechanical meaning.
_notes.caps: See MECHANICS.md §2.4 (refund floor) and §6.3 (information cap). Both are enforced in the engine, not per relic.
_notes.upgrades: Every relic carries exactly one upgrade tier, applied at a Forge node (MECHANICS.md §6.7). Consumables are not upgradeable. An upgrade never changes a relic's hook, archetype, rarity or code — only its rule. The card is the same object with an MK.II badge.

TEMPO.label: TEMPO
TEMPO.summary: Rewarded for solving in three or fewer.

RISK.label: RISK
RISK.summary: High variance. Wagers and corrupted information.

ROUTE.label: ROUTING
ROUTE.summary: Changes how the map is navigated rather than how a word is solved.

relics.name: LEXICON
relics.rule: Your first guess of each word also reports how many vowels the answer holds.

upgrade.name: LEXICON MK.II
upgrade.rule: The vowel count arrives at word start, before your first guess, instead of alongside it.

relics.name: THE SIEVE
relics.rule: Grey letters fall out of the keyboard and stay out for the rest of the word.

upgrade.name: THE SIEVE MK.II
upgrade.rule: Greys lock out for the whole act, not just the word.

relics.engine_note: Locked keys must be unfocusable so a physical keyboard cannot bypass the lock.
relics.anti_synergy_reason: Rangefinder withholds letter identity, so there is nothing for the Sieve to eliminate.

relics.name: PALIMPSEST
relics.rule: At word start, learn one letter this solution shares with the previous solution. If they share none, learn that instead.

upgrade.name: PALIMPSEST MK.II
upgrade.rule: Learn two shared letters instead of one.

relics.name: RANGEFINDER
relics.rule: Yellow tiles report how many positions off the letter sits, and stop reporting which letter it is.

upgrade.name: RANGEFINDER MK.II
upgrade.rule: Yellows report direction as well as distance. Two places left reads differently from two places right.

relics.engine_note: Sets Tile.letter to null and Tile.distance to an integer. For a tile where trustworthy === false, emit a random distance drawn from the values legal for the reported state. See MECHANICS.md §4.4.

relics.name: THE CONCORDANCE
relics.rule: Your first guess of each word also reports whether the answer repeats any letter.

upgrade.name: THE CONCORDANCE MK.II
upgrade.rule: Also reports how many distinct letters the answer holds.

relics.name: CARTOGRAPHER
relics.rule: See the modifiers on every node in the act before choosing a path.

upgrade.name: CARTOGRAPHER MK.II
upgrade.rule: Also shows which relic archetype each reward node will offer.

relics.name: THE AUDITOR
relics.rule: Once per word, at any time, name one untried letter and pay 5g. He stamps it PRESENT or ABSENT. If you cannot pay, he does not answer.

upgrade.name: THE AUDITOR MK.II
upgrade.rule: He stamps free.

relics.name: THE FENCE
relics.rule: Reveals cost 30% less.

upgrade.name: THE FENCE MK.II
upgrade.rule: Reveals cost half, not thirty percent less.

relics.flavor: He knows what a letter is worth. It is less than you paid.
relics.engine_note: Read as data by revealCost, not fired as a hook: a price is a query, not a state change. The declared hook is nominal and the relic registers no handler. Discounts multiply and the price floors at 1g, so no stack of them makes a reveal free.

relics.name: THE HOLDOUT
relics.rule: Solve a word without buying a reveal and gain 25g.

upgrade.name: THE HOLDOUT MK.II
upgrade.rule: Solving without buying a reveal pays 45g.

relics.flavor: Paid nothing. Learned nothing. Won anyway.
relics.anti_synergy_reason: The Fence makes reveals cheap enough to be worth buying; the Holdout pays you not to buy them. Holding both leaves one of the two idle on every word.

relics.name: THE ANVIL
relics.rule: Forge nodes give you two operations instead of one. Act pool reduced by 1.

upgrade.name: THE ANVIL MK.II
upgrade.rule: The pool penalty is lifted. Two forge operations, no weight.

relics.name: THE METRONOME
relics.rule: Solve in exactly three and gain 10g.

upgrade.name: THE METRONOME MK.II
upgrade.rule: Solve in exactly three: 10g and one guess back.

relics.name: FLYWHEEL
relics.rule: Solve in three or fewer and one guess spins straight back into the pool.

upgrade.name: FLYWHEEL MK.II
upgrade.rule: Refunds two guesses instead of one.
upgrade.engine_note: Two is the maximum useful value. Under the MECHANICS.md §2.4 floor a word costs a minimum of 1 guess net, so a 3-guess solve refunding 2 already sits on the floor. A third would be dead.

relics.name: HOT STREAK
relics.rule: Three consecutive solves in three or fewer, and the next word opens with one green revealed. The counter resets on any solve of four or more.

upgrade.name: HOT STREAK MK.II
upgrade.rule: The streak needs two consecutive solves, not three.

relics.name: OPENING GAMBIT
relics.rule: Your first guess of a word is refunded if it contains four or more unique letters not yet used this word.

upgrade.name: OPENING GAMBIT MK.II
upgrade.rule: Three unique unused letters is enough.

relics.engine_note: Implemented as a refund, never as a skipped decrement. The pool must visibly tick down and back up. See MECHANICS.md §2.4 Rule C.

relics.name: THE GUILLOTINE
relics.rule: Solve in two or fewer: gain 40g. Solve in five or more: lose 20g.

upgrade.name: THE GUILLOTINE MK.II
upgrade.rule: Two or fewer pays 60g. Five or more still costs 20g.

relics.name: BLOODHOUND
relics.rule: Elite nodes refund 2 guesses on clear, and award no gold.

upgrade.name: BLOODHOUND MK.II
upgrade.rule: Elites refund three guesses. They still pay nothing.

relics.name: THE PILGRIM
relics.rule: Passing a shop node without buying anything grants 30g on leaving.

upgrade.name: THE PILGRIM MK.II
upgrade.rule: 50g, and passing a forge without using it pays the same.

relics.name: THE WISHBONE
relics.rule: Each guess has a 50% chance of being refunded.

upgrade.name: THE WISHBONE MK.II
upgrade.rule: The odds are two in three.

relics.name: THE MOTH
relics.rule: At every word start it eats one letter off your keyboard and hands you a guess for it. It never eats a letter present in the solution.

upgrade.name: THE MOTH MK.II
upgrade.rule: It eats a letter and hands you two guesses.
upgrade.engine_note: Fires on onWordStart, so it stacks with onWordSolved refunds — different events, so the highest-refund-only rule does not merge them. The §2.4 floor is what caps the combination.

relics.flavor: It eats the alphabet, not the word.
relics.engine_note: Uses the shared eligibleLettersForRemoval(solution) helper. Unit-test that the eaten letter is never in the solution.

relics.name: BLINDFOLD
relics.rule: Choose to take no feedback on a guess. If that guess was within one letter of the solution, gain 3 guesses. Otherwise nothing.

upgrade.name: BLINDFOLD MK.II
upgrade.rule: Within two letters is enough.

relics.engine_note: "Within one letter" is Hamming distance <= 1: the guess and the solution are the same length, and at most one position differs. Transpositions do not count. Ruled in R-017.

relics.name: ALL IN
relics.rule: Before a word, wager any number of guesses. Solve within that count and gain the same number back. Fail and lose all of them.

upgrade.name: ALL IN MK.II
upgrade.rule: A lost wager costs half of what you staked, rounded down.
upgrade.engine_note: Cost reduction rather than payout increase, deliberately. RL.21 already carries a balance_flag; raising the upside would compound it.

relics.balance_flag: Pairs degenerately with any relic that removes uncertainty about your own solve count. Watch RL.04 and RL.07 co-occurrence in simulation.

relics.name: POLYGLOT
relics.rule: Six- and seven-letter words award double gold and roll relic offers one rarity tier higher.

upgrade.name: POLYGLOT MK.II
upgrade.rule: Also applies to Mirror words and boss words.

relics.name: THE TIN CUP
relics.rule: Every guess you spend rattles 5g loose.

upgrade.name: THE TIN CUP MK.II
upgrade.rule: +8g a guess, up from 5g.

relics.engine_note: The +5g must land on the same frame as the pool decrement, or the two counters compete for attention.

relics.name: THE LEDGER
relics.rule: Leftover guesses convert at 15g each instead of 10g.

upgrade.name: THE LEDGER MK.II
upgrade.rule: Leftover guesses convert at 22g.

relics.name: INSURANCE
relics.rule: The first emergency guess of each act is free.

upgrade.name: INSURANCE MK.II
upgrade.rule: The first two emergency guesses each act are free.

relics.name: THE LANTERN
relics.rule: After two failed guesses on a word, the first letter is lit for free.

upgrade.name: THE LANTERN MK.II
upgrade.rule: It lights after one failed guess, not two.

relics.flavor: It only lights the way once you are lost.

relics.name: THE VAULT
relics.rule: Up to 10 leftover guesses carry into the next act instead of converting to gold. Does not raise the act cap.

upgrade.name: THE VAULT MK.II
upgrade.rule: Carries up to sixteen.

relics.name: SHAVED COIN
relics.rule: Once per word, re-roll which positions report truthfully. You do not get to see the roll.

upgrade.name: SHAVED COIN MK.II
upgrade.rule: Twice per word. You still do not see the roll.

relics.flavor: Heads it tells you. Tails it does not.
relics.engine_note: Nothing reports untruthfully unless the Liar Letter modifier is active, and that is Act III only, so the relic is inert before then. Offered from Act III onwards rather than given a second clause. Ruled in R-016.

relics.name: THE MASK
relics.rule: Fully immune to the Liar Letter modifier. Corruption transforms are skipped entirely.

upgrade.name: THE MASK MK.II
upgrade.rule: Also immune to Fog.

relics.name: OUROBOROS
relics.rule: On death, restart the current act with your relics intact. Once per run, then it is spent.

upgrade.name: OUROBOROS MK.II
upgrade.rule: You restart the act with your gold as well as your relics.
upgrade.engine_note: This also settles a rule the base relic left unspecified: at MK.I gold is lost on revival, at MK.II it is kept.

relics.balance_flag: Removes the downside of any wager. Watch co-occurrence with RL.20 and RL.21 in simulation.

relics.name: ROSETTA SLAB
relics.rule: Every word opens with one green already carved. In exchange the act pool is cut by three.

upgrade.name: ROSETTA SLAB MK.II
upgrade.rule: The act pool is cut by one instead of three.

relics.flavor: Older than the language it breaks.

consumables.name: THE SPYGLASS
consumables.rule: Reveals the vowel count and repeat flag of the current word.

consumables.name: THE POULTICE
consumables.rule: Clears every modifier from the current word.

consumables.name: THE DECANTER
consumables.rule: Pours 3 guesses into the act pool. Does not raise the cap.

consumables.name: SKELETON KEY
consumables.rule: Turns one green on the next word you enter.

characters.name: THE LINGUIST
characters.innate: Sees the solution vowel count on every word, before the first guess.

characters.name: THE GAMBLER
characters.innate: Solving in three or fewer refunds two guesses.
characters.engine_note: Under the highest-refund-only rule, this does not stack with RL.11 Flywheel. A Gambler holding Flywheel who solves in three gets 2, not 3.

characters.name: THE CRYPTOGRAPHER
characters.innate: May spend a guess to reveal one letter outright, at any time, on any word.
characters.engine_note: No use cap: the guess it costs is the cap.
